Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP and next steps - NovaHealth

Thanks again for the call this morning — good discussion and helpful context on NovaHealth's priorities. As discussed, attached is the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones, owners, and dependencies. Please review and confirm any changes so we can lock the timeline and SOW.

Summary / Ask:
- Please review the attached MAP (draft v1) and comment on any missing milestones or incorrect owners by EOD Thu 3/19.
- Confirm target close date and procurement gating items so we can align internal resourcing.

Key milestones (from call):
- Procurement sign-off (NovaHealth procurement) — Owner: Ravi Menon — Target: 2026-04-15
- Legal review & redlines — Owner: NovaHealth Legal — Target: 2026-04-22
- Technical POC (3 end-to-end tests) — Owner: Jonas Weber / Redwood Eng — Target: 2026-04-10
- Final SOW & PO — Owner: Marissa Cole / NovaHealth Procurement — Target: 2026-04-25

I've also attached the current SOW draft (v1) for reference. If there are any internal dependencies we missed (procurement approvals, security questionnaire items), flag them and we'll add to the MAP.

Next steps:
- Ravi / Sasha: confirm procurement timeline and any additional approvers
- Jonas / Engineering: prepare POC plan for next week once procurement gating items are clear
- I'll incorporate comments and circulate MAP v2 by Wed 3/18

Attachments: NovaHealth-MAP-Draft-v1.pdf, SOW_NovaHealth_v1.docx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Marissa, thanks for the recap. Quick update from procurement — our budgeting cycle slipped and we now expect approvals to land in mid-May rather than mid-April. That changes our target close materially.

Can you reprioritize the MAP so procurement gating items are first and shift non-blocking work (integration tuning) later in the plan? I've attached our internal procurement timeline for reference.

Ravi

Proposed MAP updates:
- Reforecast target close date: 2026-05-28 (from 2026-04-25)
- Milestone reprioritization: move Procurement sign-off to the top, freeze Legal review to follow Procurement, postpone non-blocking integration tuning until after SOW/PO
- New dependency: Internal NovaHealth budget committee meeting (Owner: Ravi Menon) — target 2026-05-05

We'll attach the updated MAP (NovaHealth-MAP-Draft-v2.pdf) and a redlined SOW where needed. Can we book 30 minutes on Thu 3/19 to walk the updated plan and agree on owners/dates? Suggest 10:00–10:30 PT.

If that time doesn't work, propose two alternatives and we'll adjust. Once we have alignment I'll update the HubSpot deal record and share the DocuSign timeline for signatures.

Thanks,
